blurb: Guests book charter trips on a 43' Viking Convertible boat for sportfishing in offshore canyons and inshore lumps east of Ocean City inlet. Target species include white marlin, blue marlin, yellow fin tuna, blue fin tuna, big eye tuna, mahi, mako shark, thresher shark, swordfish, wahoo, sea bass, and tilefish. The boat is equipped with modern amenities and custom fishing gear.
extraNote: Ocean City Fishing Center, Slip B-7, West Ocean City, Maryland
